title: Efim Liberman's research on cytoskeletal learning

tellings.quote: liberman two friends of mine denil and David liberman their father knew uh hamov and or I think knew Penrose rather and was uh really interested in cytoskeletal learning

plain: A Soviet scientist named Efim Liberman was deeply interested in cytoskeletal learning, the idea that the tiny scaffolding inside cells helps the brain learn. Michels tells this himself, from his friends Daniil and David Liberman, Efim's sons, and says their father knew the physicist Roger Penrose or perhaps the anesthesiologist Stuart Hameroff, two men known for linking the brain to quantum physics. He brings it up as an early sign of the idea that the brain works at a quantum level.
